step_results:
Your gym membership issue is fixed! The problem was floating-point precision in the `parseEuros` and `cellCents` functions. When converting decimal euro amounts to whole cents (e.g., 39.95 → 3995), JavaScript's arithmetic produced `3995.0000000000005`, which failed the integer validation. 

Adding `Math.round()` to both functions ensures we always get a proper whole number. The fix has been tested and all 50 tests pass, including your exact command:

```bash
$ subtrack add Gym 39.95 --since 2026-10-03
Added Gym: €39.95 monthly, €39.95 a month, next charge 2026-12-03.
```

Netflix and Spotify continue to work perfectly as well. The fix is ready to commit whenever you approve.
